svg.title: Resume system architecture: three-layer model from base data to JD-tailored outputs
svg.desc: A structural diagram showing Layer 1 (single source of truth in YAML), Layer 2 (a composition engine with JD matching and template selection), and Layer 3 (output versions: PDF, web, cover letter) with a tracking log below.

g.text: One YAML / JSON file you own and version-control
JD goes in → tailored resume comes out
generated, tracked, stored by job ID

svg.text: Each application = a named snapshot: company + role + date + which sections + which template
You can always regenerate any version from the base — no more filename chaos
